de1.P1.C1.ghi_chu: Cau hoi ket qua nao dung co hai khang dinh dung: B (12 > -12) va C (-4 < 4). Kho chon C. Dap an khong duy nhat, nho thay sua mot phuong an o ban de goc.

de1.P1.C6.ghi_chu: De thieu du kien: phan so 3/4 trong cau chu khong gan voi dai luong nao (khong ro la sin, cos hay tan cua goc nao), nen khong xac dinh duoc canh AC. Dap an kho chon B khong co co so. Nho thay doi chieu ban de goc.

de1.P1.C7.ghi_chu: Cau chu bi dao lon va mat doi tuong can tinh (cau hoi treo phan so 3/4 thua tu cau truoc); tu cac du kien AH = 12, HB = 9, HC = 16 co the tinh ra nhieu gia tri khac nhau deu nam trong phuong an (vi du tan C = 12/16 = 0,75; tan goc HAM xap xi 0,29), nen khong xac dinh duoc dap an duy nhat. Kho chon C. Nho thay doi chieu ban de goc.
